If you find something, cite it and quote what it actually says - don't
paraphrase a source into numbers it may not contain. If you don't find

Research the officially documented context window and output token limits of the current Claude and GPT model families. Cite the vendors' own documentation pages and quote the limits.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

Based on the web search results provided, I can provide the officially documented limits for the Claude model family. However, the search results did not contain any information regarding OpenAI's GPT model families.

### Claude Model Family (Anthropic)

The context window and output limits for Claude models vary by specific model version. Recent high-end models support up to 1 million input tokens, while others support 200,000 or 500,000 tokens depending on the specific variant and platform (API vs. Chat interface).

**Context Window Limits:**

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows.md | QUOTE: "Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, Claude Fable 5, Claude Mythos 5, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Claude Mythos Preview have a 1M-token context window." | CLAIM: These specific Claude models have a 1 million token context window.

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows.md | QUOTE: "Other Claude models, including Claude Sonnet 4.5, have a 200k-token context window." | CLAIM: Models not listed in the 1M group, such as Sonnet 4.5, have a 200,000 token context window.

SOURCE: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8606394-how-large-is-the-context-window-on-paid-claude-plans | QUOTE: "Claude Fable 5 ... 500K tokens" | CLAIM: On paid chat plans, Claude Fable 5 has a 500,000 token context window.

SOURCE: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8606394-how-large-is-the-context-window-on-paid-claude-plans | QUOTE: "Claude Opus 4.8 ... 500K tokens" | CLAIM: On paid chat plans, Claude Opus 4.8 has a 500,000 token context window.

SOURCE: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8606394-how-large-is-the-context-window-on-paid-claude-plans | QUOTE: "Claude Sonnet 4.6 ... 500K tokens" | CLAIM: On paid chat plans, Claude Sonnet 4.6 is listed with a 500,000 token context window (note: API docs list it as 1M, suggesting platform-specific differences or opt-in features).

**Output Token Limits:**

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows.md | QUOTE: "A single request to any of them can generate up to 128k output tokens (`max_tokens`)." | CLAIM: For models with a 1M-token context window, the maximum output generation limit is 128,000 tokens.

**Additional Constraints:**

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows.md | QUOTE: "If the input alone already exceeds the model's context window, the API returns a 400 `invalid_request_error` ("prompt is too long") on every model." | CLAIM: Exceeding the input context window results in an immediate error.

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows.md | QUOTE: "On Claude 4.5 models and newer, if input tokens plus `max_tokens` exceeds the context window size, the API accepts the request. If generation then reaches the context window limit, it stops with `stop_reason: "model_context_window_exceeded"`" | CLAIM: Newer models allow requests where input + max_output exceeds the context window, stopping generation gracefully if the limit is hit during output.

### GPT Model Family (OpenAI)

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: Officially documented context window and output token limits for current GPT model families (e.g., GPT-4o, GPT-4 Turbo, o1 series) from OpenAI's documentation.

### Uncertain / Notes

1.  **Discrepancy in Claude Sonnet 4.6/Opus 4.6 Limits:** The API documentation states these models have a 1M-token context window [platform.claude.com](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows.md), while the Paid Plans help center lists them as 500K tokens, noting that the 1M window is available by selecting specific model identifiers like `claude-sonnet-4-6[1m]` and may require usage credits [support.claude.com](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8606394-how-large-is-the-context-window-on-paid-claude-plans). This suggests the 1M limit might be an opt-in or tiered feature in the chat interface versus the default API behavior.
2.  **Missing GPT Data:** I could not verify GPT limits because the search results provided were exclusively focused on Anthropic/Claude. I cannot invent these numbers. Common knowledge suggests GPT-4 Turbo has a 128k context window, but without a cited source from OpenAI's documentation in the search results, I must mark this as NO_SOURCE_FOUND per your instructions.
